title: Claim degenerate delimited tables
lead: The delimited profiler claims three shapes it now rejects as "not a delimited table": a header with no data row, a one-column file, and a file with a row of another width among its first two data rows. Each is described with its evidence (row counts, field counts, the ragged line). **Not in this slice:** new regions or dialects.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A library consumer (a lab sweep-table splitter in another repo) uses squalify as its only describer and must fail or classify these files by its own rules, not lose them at the describe step.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - the delimited profiler and its tests, descriptor docs and the schema if a field changes, README

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A header-only file is claimed: header found, zero data rows.
- A one-column file is claimed with its single field.
- A ragged row among the first two data rows is reported as ragged, and the table is still found.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implemented (implementer, 2026-10-27, after fix round 1). Decisions are the owner decisions quoted in the notes.

Code:
- Run start (one place, DialectSelector.StartWindowHolds): no lead rule. The window ends at the last k-field record, so a footer of any length never counts. It skips ragged records with two or more fields, comment lines (pass 1 flags them: RecordInfo.IsComment, FieldCountRun.CommentRecords) and a one-field line once 4 k-field records (header plus three rows) came before it (RunStartMinRecordsBeforeStrayLine); an earlier one-field line (title, key=value) ends the window (sq-28).
- DegenerateShapes.cs holds the policy for the two degenerate shapes: header-only (header within limits.headerSample lines, preamble of blank/comment/key=value lines, single-word distinct non-numeric cells, quoted cells exempt from the whitespace rule; table.rows 0, issue noDataRows, constantLineLength false) and one column (every non-whitespace candidate sees one field, at least 3 records, the HeaderDetector's eligible header, delimiter written as the word none). DialectSelector only sets the per-candidate LooksHeaderOnly and LooksSingleColumn flags. Evidence dialect/shape lists both shapes.
- Docs: design.md, descriptor.md, how-it-works.md and renders.

Tests (tests/squalify.Tests/DegenerateTableTests.cs): HeaderOnly_IsClaimed_WithZeroDataRows; HeaderOnly_EachDelimiter_AndWithoutAFinalLineBreak; HeaderOnly_AfterAPreamble_KeepsThePreamble; HeaderOnly_NotAHeader_StaysText; HeaderOnly_SingleWordNamesOrQuotedCells_AreAHeader; HeaderOnly_WritesNoConstantLineLength_AndAnEvidenceEntryForBothShapes; HeaderOnly_HeaderBeyondTheHeaderSample_StaysText; NoDataRowsIssue_IsAbsent_WhenTheTableHasRows; OneColumn_WithAClearHeader_IsClaimedWithK1; OneColumn_HeaderAndTwoValues_IsTheSmallestClaim; OneColumn_WithAClearHeader_WritesTheWordNone_InDialectHintsAndEvidence; OneColumn_QuotedCellsHoldingDelimiters_StayOneColumn; OneColumn_ProseLogOrNoClearHeader_StaysText; RaggedAmongTheFirstTwoDataRecords_IsReported_AndTheHeaderIsKept; RaggedAmongTheFirstDataRecords_ASmallTable_IsStillDelimitedWithItsHeader; RunStartWindow_SkipsOnlyMultiFieldRaggedRecords_OneFieldLinesStayPreamble; RunStartWindow_SkipsAMultiFieldRaggedRecord_AfterAOneRecordLead; RunStartWindow_SkipsACommentLine_InsideTheWindow; RunStartWindow_SkipsATrailingOneFieldFooter; RunStartWindow_SeveralFooterLines_AreATable; RunStartWindow_StrayOneFieldLine_InsideTheTable_IsRaggedAndKeepsTheHeader; RunStartWindow_OneFieldLine_BeforeTheTable_StillEndsTheWindow; CommentProbe_AgreesWithLineClassifier. Goldens: delimited/header-only.csv, one-column.csv, ragged-first-rows.csv.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes. A release that a consumer can pin follows (owner step).

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: The owner commits. Do not commit; never add Co-Authored-By or similar lines.
